title: Cold rebuild: Spring cleaning
summary: Rebuild Spring cleaning from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Spring cleaning** in *Bulk updates and deletes*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Spring cleaning cold
prompt: The tests give you `ShopDb` with `Items` (`Id`, `Name`, `Stock`, `PriceCents`). Write `(int Discounted, int Removed) Clean(ShopDb db)` that, **in one transaction**:
1. halves the price (integer division) of every item with more than 5 in stock, using `ExecuteUpdate`,
2. deletes every item with no stock, using `ExecuteDelete`,
No entity may be loaded: the tests count the commands.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
